en: The image shows a panoramic black-and-white view of a town nestled at the edge of a forest and hills. The town features ornate, historic multi-story buildings and villas, with one central, domed pavilion-like structure and a large, elaborate building that may be a spa or hotel. The architectural style suggests Central European influences, with dense forest and hilly terrain in the background.
